lcc_original: 拉麥在世的日子、共有七百七十七年，然後死。
notes: WH03117 (יוֹם/days) was implicit {} in UNV; LCC has explicit 日子, so braces dropped per Rule 3
WAH01961+WTH8799 (הָיָה/were) was implicit {} in UNV; LCC has explicit 有 in 共有, so braces dropped per Rule 3

Two WH08141 (שָׁנָה/year) in UNV: first is orphaned between 百 and 七十 with no explicit UNV character and no braces; second attaches to 歲; Hebrew has three שָׁנָה tokens total; LCC condenses all to a single 年, so both tags attach to 年 per Rule 6
在世的 is a Chinese periphrastic expansion of the Hebrew genitive construct (יְמֵי = days-of); no dedicated SN, left unannotated per Rule 5
然後 is a LCC connective (then/thereafter) with no Hebrew equivalent in the source; left unannotated per Rule 5
